en: Color postcard showing a solitary round stone tower with a conical red‑tile roof. Around the upper part of the tower there is a wooden overhanging gallery with windows. The tower stands beside a dirt road lined with leafless or early‑spring trees; a single person is walking in the distance. The scene is rural and calm under a clear blue sky. No visible printed text appears on the image side.
